AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 17, 2025
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Katie Larson, Chair  Ryan Gales, Commissioner
Mark Christoffels, Vice Chair  Mireya LaFarga, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Geetanjali Reuben, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner  Marva Thomas, Commissioner
  Randy Zarn, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  LGBARPT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55727  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the Airport Advisory Commission
  meeting on June 18, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55728  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight, featuring Matt Liknaitzk with Sling Pilot Academy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55733  Recommendation to establish an ad-hoc Committee for the limited purpose of
  recommending methods to increase attendance at and develop sponsorship
  opportunities for the 2025 Festival of Flight Event, with such Committee
  terminating upon the completion of the event.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55729  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability Committee,
  regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality, energy conservation, water
  quality, and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55761  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Wings of Fame Program

AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, JULY 17, 2025
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Katie Larson, Chair  Ryan Gales, Commissioner
Mark Christoffels, Vice Chair  Mireya LaFarga, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Geetanjali Reuben, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner  Marva Thomas, Commissioner
  Randy Zarn, Commissioner

  FINAL AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER
At 4:00 p.m., Chair Larson called the meeting to order.
ROLL CALL
Commissioners Present: Arias, Brown, Larson, Zarn, Thomas

Commissioners Absent: LaFarga, Christoffels, Reuben, Gales
REGULAR AGENDA
1. 25-55727 Recommendation to approve the minutes from the Airport Advisory
  Commission meeting on June 18, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Brown, seconded by Commissioner
  Arias, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:
  Yes:  4 Arias, Larson, Zarn, Thomas
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 Brown, LaFarga, Christoffels, Reuben, Gales
2. 25-55728 Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB
  Business Partner Spotlight, featuring Matt Liknaitzk with Sling Pilot
  Academy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Arias, seconded by Commissioner
  Larson, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:
  Yes:  5 Arias, Brown, Larson, Zarn, Thomas
   No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 4  LaFarga, Christoffels, Reuben, Gales

  Kate Kuykendall, Public Affairs Officer, presented the report.

  Juan Lopez-Rios, Deputy Director, spoke.

  Commissioner Brown spoke.

  Kate Kuykendall spoke.

  Justin Cook, Noise and Capacity Management Officer, spoke.

  Commissioner Brown spoke.

  A dialog ensued.

  Mony Chhey, Financial Services Officer, spoke.

  Commissioner Brown spoke.

  A dialog ensued.

  Juan Lopez-Rios spoke.

3. 25-55733 Recommendation to establish an ad-hoc Committee for the limited
  purpose of recommending methods to increase attendance at and
  develop sponsorship opportunities for the 2025 Festival of Flight Event,
  with such Committee terminating upon the completion of the event.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Brown, seconded by Commissioner
  Arias, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:
  Yes:  5 Arias, Brown, Larson, Zarn, Thomas
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 4 LaFarga, Christoffels, Reuben, Gales

  Commissioners Brown and Thomas were appointed to the Committee.

4. 25-55729 Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability
  Committee, regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality,
   energy conservation, water quality, and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Chair Larson presented the report.

  Commissioner Zarn spoke.

  Juan Lopez-Rios spoke.

  A dialog ensued.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Zarn, seconded by Commissioner
  Brown, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:
  Yes:  5 Arias, Brown, Larson, Zarn, Thomas
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 4 LaFarga, Christoffels, Reuben, Gales
5. 25-55761 Recommendation to receive and file report from the Wings of Fame
  Program Committee, regarding clarification of exhibit goals and
  inductee nomination criteria.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Zarn, seconded by Commissioner
  Brown, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:
  Yes:  5 Arias, Brown, Larson, Zarn, Thomas
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 4 LaFarga, Christoffels, Reuben, Gales

  Chair Larson presented the report.

6. 25-55730 Recommendation to receive and file Monthly Airport Staff Reports for
  June 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Juan Lopez-Rios presented the Director’s report.

  Mony Chhey presented the Finance update.
   Justin Cook presented the Monthly Noise report.

  Kate Kuykendall presented the Public Affairs Report.

  Juan Lopez-Rios spoke.

  A dialog ensued.

  Commissioner Thomas spoke.

  Commissioner Zarn spoke.

  Mony Chhey spoke.

  Chair Larson spoke.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Brown, seconded by Commissioner
  Thomas, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:
  Yes:  5 Arias, Brown, Larson, Zarn, Thomas
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 4 LaFarga, Christoffels, Reuben, Gales

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was no public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

There were no announcements.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Larson adjourned the meeting at 4:52 p.m.
